criterion.given: The codebase has components using class-variance-authority (CVA)
criterion.then: All components in src/components/ui/ use tailwind-variants instead of CVA: - Import tv and VariantProps from tailwind-variants - Use tv() function instead of cva() - Maintain backward compatibility (same component API) - All existing variants preserved

The migration includes: - Button component migrated - Badge component migrated - Alert component migrated - Label component migrated - Toast component migrated - Sheet component migrated - Navigation Menu component migrated - Card component enhanced with tailwind-variants (if not already done) - Any other UI components using CVA

After migration: - All components maintain identical APIs (no breaking changes) - All existing tests pass without modification - Type safety is maintained or improved - Component variants work identically to before

Cleanup includes: - class-variance-authority dependency can be removed from package.json (optional) - No remaining imports of class-variance-authority in codebase - Documentation updated to reflect tailwind-variants usage

doc.title: Sprint Change Proposal: UI/UX Design System Enhancement
doc.snippet: Migration from CVA to tailwind-variants for better type safety and more flexible variant composition. All 7 components (Button, Badge, Alert, Label, Toast, Sheet, Navigation Menu) have been migrated. Card component enhanced with new variants.

doc.title: Architecture
doc.snippet: ShadCN/UI copy-paste model - components are in src/components/ui/ directory. Styling uses Tailwind CSS 3.3.0 with utility-first approach. Type safety maintained with TypeScript 5.0.0 strict mode.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: Epic 3 focuses on player analytics with role-based performance metrics. Story 3.1 is part of design system enhancement to migrate components to tailwind-variants for better type safety and composition capabilities.

doc.title: Story 3.1: Migrate Components to Tailwind Variants
doc.snippet: Component patterns established from ShadCN/UI. Migration from class-variance-authority to tailwind-variants for better type safety and composition. All components maintain backward compatibility with same APIs.

package.name: class-variance-authority
package.note: Can be removed after migration verification

constraint.rule: UI components must be in src/components/ui/ following ShadCN/UI patterns
Tailwind CSS 3.3.0 with utility-first approach. All styling must use Tailwind utilities.
TypeScript 5.0.0 with strict mode - maintain type safety during migration. All components must have proper TypeScript types.
All components must maintain backward compatibility - same component API, no breaking changes.
Use tailwind-variants tv() function instead of class-variance-authority cva(). Import VariantProps from tailwind-variants.
All existing tests must pass without modification. Maintain minimum 80% test coverage.
Use Yarn exclusively for package management. Never use npm.

interface.name: VariantProps
interface.note: Type helper for extracting variant prop types from tv() definitions. Used in all component prop interfaces.

interface.name: tv
interface.note: Function for creating variant definitions. Replaces cva() from class-variance-authority. Accepts base, variants, defaultVariants, and compoundVariants.

interface.name: cn
interface.note: Utility for merging className strings. Combines clsx and tailwind-merge. Used by all components to merge variant classes with custom className props.

tests.standards: Test-Driven Development (TDD) is mandatory. All code must have corresponding tests. Test coverage must be maintained above 80%. Use React Testing Library for component tests. Follow Red-Green-Refactor cycle. All existing tests must pass after migration without modification. Component tests should verify variant functionality, TypeScript types, and backward compatibility.
